description: Disposal of a plot of land located at Perahera Mawatha, Kollupitiya, Colombo 03 belonging to the Urban Development Authority for a mixed development project on 99 year lease basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2024-09-13, has granted approval for the disposal of a plot of land in extent of 02 roods and 23.1 perches, located at Perahera Mawatha, Kollupitiya, Colombo 03, to an investor selected to implement a mixed development project, including residential purposes. The Standing Cabinet Appointed Negotiating Committee has recommended to cancel the leasing out of the said land due to the failure of the investor to meet the relevant transfer conditions. Similarly, the Board of Management of the Urban Development Authority held on 2025-09-04 has granted approval to re-call investment proposals to dispose the said land for a suitable development purpose. Further, the Expert Committee appointed by the Cabinet regarding the disposal of the lands of the Urban Development Authority has approved the invitation of investment proposals for the use of the relevant land for hotel or commercial purposes, subject to the condition that a maximum of 50% of the land can be used for residential purposes. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to invite proposals under the international competitive procurement method for the disposal of the relevant plot of land on 99-year lease basis based on the valuation of the Chief Government Valuer, was approved by the Cabinet.
